subject: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: treynolds@bluehaven.com
Date: 2025-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot

Team —

Quick context: Bluehaven wants an on-prem pilot (VPC + enclave) for a single production workload starting mid-July. They expect limited traffic but require isolated network, KMS integration, and 30d audit logs. The ask: we need a lightweight operator playbook that covers runbook steps, escalation, and a temporary oncall model for the pilot.

Constraints: we don't have the full private deployment staffing committed for Q3. I'm requesting an exception to the default staffing gating: allow a pilot with a reduced oncall (business-hours primary + on-call rota for critical incidents) for 6 weeks, contingent on the runbook, compliance checklist, and a signed SOW.

Attached: runbook-draft.pdf (working draft).

Asks:
- Karthik — estimate the minimal infra/SRE effort to support the pilot (FTE or contractor-hours).
- Soojin — operational constraints (backup/restore, canary options) and whether the reduced oncall is acceptable.
- Naomi — confirm compliance checklist gaps that must be closed pre-launch.
- Monica — coordinate procurement + DocuSign SOW with Bluehaven procurement (cc'd).

Target: pilot kickoff 2025-07-15. Please reply with concrete blockers or an explicit "we cannot" by EOD Friday (6/06).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot

Jordan —

Thanks for the brief. Quick technical questions and a preliminary staffing note:

Questions:
- KV cache persistence: will Bluehaven accept cold-starts on worker rotation or do they need warm cache with persisted state? Persisted cache increases infra complexity by ~1.0 engineer day to prototype and ~0.2 FTE ongoing.
- Telemetry: do we need full token-level traces shipped off-network, or is aggregated telemetry sufficient? Off-network telemetry triggers compliance concerns.
- Quantization/kernel profile: which model variant are we serving? Smaller variants reduce GPU footprint significantly; that affects the staffing estimate.

Staffing/effort (very rough):
- Pilot prep: 2.5 engineer-weeks (runtime + networking configuration)
- Runbook + automation: 1.0 engineer-week
- Oncall coverage recommendation: 0.5 FTE SRE (shared) + 0.3 infra engineer for initial 6-week window

I can refine if we lock model variant and confirm KV/telemetry requirements. I attached a quick staffing_estimate.csv with assumptions.

- Karthik
Lead, Runtime Engineering

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot

Jordan / all —

Operational notes from an ops perspective:
- Canary policy: recommend a phased canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on error-rate spike. Canary requires automation hooks in the runbook; adding that is ~2-3 days of work.
- Backup/restore: for pilot we can get away with nightly exports + on-demand restores; this keeps ops weight low but increases recovery RTO to ~4 hours.
- Oncall: reduced oncall (business-hours primary + critical incident Rota) is acceptable for a timeboxed pilot if Bluehaven agrees in writing to limited SLA (no 99.9 guarantee). We should list incident severity matrix in the runbook.

Risks: if Bluehaven expects 24/7 coverage or low latency SLOs, we will need to escalate staffing and push pilot start.

Action: I'll add a canary checklist section to the runbook.

— Soojin
Principal, Site Reliability

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: treynolds@bluehaven.com, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-07T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot

Tom —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per Jordan's request, attaching our standard SOW template for pilots (SOW-template_bluehaven-v1.docx). A couple of procurement notes:
- We need a signed SOW and the standard security addendum before infra work begins.
- Payment terms: Net 30 is fine; we'll convert the pilot to a committed dedicated arrangement if it meets acceptance criteria.
- DocuSign: I'll push a draft to your procurement inbox today (link below).

@internal: I'll track signatures and liaise with legal. If Bluehaven needs a shorter signature cycle, let me know and I'll prioritize.

Attachment: SOW-template_bluehaven-v1.docx

Monica Patel
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-08T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot

Team —

Compliance checklist (high level) — items we need confirmed before signoff: 
- KMS: Bluehaven must provide tenant KMS access or we must run with a customer-managed key in an approved HSM.
- Audit logs: 30d retention acceptable, must include request metadata and runbook-triggered actions. Storage location must be declared.
- Data residency: confirm no telemetry leaves the tenant boundary unless explicitly agreed. Aggregated metrics are acceptable if scrubbed.
- SOC2 / Attestation: A current SOC2 report (within 12 months) preferred; if unavailable, we require a compensating control.

I've attached compliance-q-answers.md with clarifying questions to send to Bluehaven procurement/security. Can we get their security contact included in thread? I need their responses no later than 2025-06-10 to meet your timeline.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: treynolds@bluehaven.com
Date: 2025-06-09T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator playbook scope + resourcing exception request for Bluehaven on-prem pilot — Summary and next steps

Team — thanks for the rapid input. Short summary / decisions so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions:
- Exception approved for a timeboxed pilot (6 weeks) with reduced oncall (business-hours primary + critical rota) provided Bluehaven signs SOW and explicitly accepts limited SLA (no 99.9% uptime guarantee).
- Karthik to firm up staffing numbers once Bluehaven confirms model variant and whether KV persistence is required — target 2 days for update.
- Soojin to add canary checklist and incident severity matrix to runbook draft — target 3 days.
- Naomi to send compliance questionnaire to Bluehaven security by EOD 6/09; we need answers by 6/10.
- Monica to circulate DocuSign SOW and chase signatures; target 6/11.

Attachments for tracking: runbook-draft.pdf, staffing_estimate.csv, SOW-template_bluehaven-v1.docx, compliance-q-answers.md

Next steps:
- Monica: push DocuSign and introduce Bluehaven security contact to Naomi.
- Karthik & Soojin: quick alignment call Tuesday 6/10 09:00 PT to finalize runbook/canary items.

If anyone objects to the exception or needs a longer runway, flag immediately. Otherwise I'll mark this as the working plan and circulate the action tracker.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
